narrative: The assessment estimated a 58% chance that you would be a bad credit risk, meaning repayment problems were judged slightly more likely than not; because this crossed the bank’s threshold, your application was denied. This is uncommon among approved applicants, only about 12.6% of whom had this status. The second most important factor was property status. To improve a future application, focus on bringing your checking account out of overdraft, building a documented savings history, and reducing either the amount or length of the loan.
